row.title: Replication Ledger keeps itself current: the hourly discovery beat is the core
row.body: Rowan, 2026-11-25: static content is not autonomous and is contrary to the objective of an Ultrastable system. The hand-written findings are now only the ledger's seed. instances/replication-ledger/worker/discover.js and store.js run an hourly beat (cron 23 * * * *, plus a spark from any request when the last beat is over two hours old). It searches OpenAlex for works citing each original that report a replication, files a kind and outcome only under a verbatim-quote guard (Workers AI, then a fixed lexical reader), keeps everything else as leads, finds landmark originals not yet held from recent replication papers' references, flags retractions and checks seed citations at Crossref. Each standing move is a standing_changes row served at /changes and /feed.json; /api/freshness answers 503 when a finding goes unchecked for thirty days. State is kept in D1 ultrastable-replication-ledger, whose schema the Worker creates itself. Probe: node --test instances/replication-ledger/worker/discover.test.mjs. Residual risk: the OpenAlex query syntax was exercised only against a fake in tests, because this session's egress refuses api.openalex.org; /api/beats records each beat's errors so the first live beat shows any mismatch.
